lines.zh: 灰跳虫在余烬上蹦着走
lines.en: The ash hopper bounces across the embers.

lines.zh: 每一下都带起一小片灰
lines.en: Each hop kicks up a little ash.

lines.zh: 它的后腿比身体长很多
lines.en: Its hind legs are far longer than its body.
One hop carries it several blocks.

lines.zh: 它落在石头上，立刻再跳
lines.en: It lands on a stone and springs again.
It arcs around a pool of lava.
Its wings spread mid-hop.
Walking, it looks almost like crawling.
It works its way down a rock face.

lines.zh: 火星在它身后拖了一小段
lines.en: Sparks trail briefly behind it.
It stops with its hind legs still loaded.
It springs to your flank.
The ash hopper rests on a stone.

lines.zh: 它的身体和灰一样颜色
lines.en: Its body is the colour of ash.
Its hind legs tuck beneath it.
Its antennae sway.

lines.zh: 它在石面上磨了磨口器
lines.en: It works its mouthparts against the stone.

lines.zh: 它的翅鞘微微张开又合上
lines.en: Its wing cases crack open and shut.
Ash settles on it; it does not stir.
It shudders once.
Its eyes are like two coals.

lines.zh: 它把身体压低贴住石面
lines.en: It presses flat to the stone.
The ash hopper rears up to look at you.
Its antennae reach toward you.
Its hind legs load slowly.
It side-hops half a step.
It seems to measure your height.
Its wing cases lift.

lines.zh: 它对你吐了一小口热气
lines.en: It puffs hot breath at you.
It turns its body to you.
Then it goes quiet again.
It fixes on your feet.
The ash hopper is knocked over.
It rights itself in a scramble.
A pale line shows on its shell.
It backs two blocks and loads up.
Its antennae curl.
It shakes its wing cases.
Its leap goes off line.
It stays still after landing.
Its breathing rasps quickly.
It still faces your way.

lines.zh: 灰跳虫朝你手上的东西跳来
lines.en: The ash hopper hops toward what you hold.
It lands almost against you.
It tests a bite with its mouthparts.
It drags the item onto a stone.
Its body swells as it feeds.
Done, it lifts its head to search.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西踢开
lines.en: What it rejects, it kicks away.
It bounces a circle around you.
It stops, waiting for more.
Its wings quiver twice.

lines.zh: 灰跳虫撞在你腿上弹开
lines.en: The ash hopper bounces off your leg.
It lands and flips over.
It rights itself and loads its legs.
It backs a block and reloads.

lines.zh: 它的硬壳撞出清脆一响
lines.en: Its shell gives a sharp knock.

lines.zh: 它在你的鞋面上蹬了一下
lines.en: It kicks off your shoe.
A puff of ash rises.
It arcs past you onto a stone.
It is warier of you now.
But it does not go far.
Two ash hoppers bounce together.
They land almost on the same spot.
Their antennae touch.

lines.zh: 它们靠在一起摩擦翅鞘
lines.en: They rub their wing cases together.
A rasping sound comes out.
Ash rises between them.

lines.zh: 它们同时跳起，又一起落下
lines.en: They leap and land as one.
They press body to body.

lines.zh: 它们的呼吸让灰微微动
lines.en: Their breathing stirs the ash.

lines.zh: 这一小块石台归它们了
lines.en: This little ledge is theirs now.

lines.zh: 灰跳虫用口器夹起食物
lines.en: The ash hopper takes the food in its mouthparts.
It drags it under a rock lip.
It bites and chews slowly.

lines.zh: 它把不合口的踢到一边
lines.en: What it dislikes, it kicks aside.
It bounces back with the prize.
Ash sticks to the food.
It puffs the ash away.
Another bite, and it seems pleased.
What is left gets pressed beneath it.

lines.zh: 它抬头，触角朝你动了动
lines.en: It lifts its head and its antennae stir.
The ash hopper's body pulls taut.
Its hind legs load to the limit.

lines.zh: 它在石头上转了个向东
lines.en: It turns to face you.

lines.zh: 它发出一阵短促的沙响
lines.en: A short rasp comes from it.
Its wing cases open.

lines.zh: 它朝你跳了一下，没落地
lines.en: It springs at you and lands short.
It loads again the moment it lands.
Its eyes burn redder.
It starts hopping around you.
It has found its angle.
Sparks come off it as it leaps.
It stops watching from a distance.
It aims at your knee.
Its antennae point at you.

lines.zh: 灰跳虫在你周围蹦来蹦去
lines.en: The ash hopper bounces around you.
Each landing is nearer.
It tries coming from above.

lines.zh: 它落在你背后的石头上
lines.en: It lands on a stone behind you.

lines.zh: 它再跳一次，撞到你肩上
lines.en: Another hop, and it hits your shoulder.
It retreats and makes a wide loop.
Its hind legs never unload.
Its antennae shiver at you.
It waits for your hand to rise.
It keeps its body low.

lines.zh: 它跳起时翅膀擦出声音
lines.en: Its wings rasp as it leaps.

lines.zh: 它落地的位置越来越刁
lines.en: Its landing spots get trickier.
It tries dropping from above.
Its shadow covers you for a moment.
The ash hopper leaps and strikes.
Its hind legs kick off your hand.

lines.zh: 它的口器夹住你的袖口
lines.en: Its mouthparts grip your cuff.
It strikes your knee, hard.
It lands and leaps straight back in.
Its wings throw a cloud of ash.
The ash gets in your eyes.
It hits your waist from the side.

lines.zh: 它退到石头上歇了一下
lines.en: It retreats to a stone to rest.

lines.zh: 它的硬壳刮过你的护甲
lines.en: Its shell scrapes your armour.
It leaps too close and tumbles.
It gets up still coming.
Its hops come faster each time.

lines.zh: 它最后落在你脚边不动
lines.en: It ends up still at your feet.
A small mound rises in the ash.
The ash hopper pushes out of the ash.
It shakes the ash off.

lines.zh: 它的翅鞘在热气里张开
lines.en: Its wing cases open in the heat.
It tries one hop.
This hop lands exactly right.
It hops again, this way.
Sparks rise with it.

lines.zh: 它停在石头上，触角探路
lines.en: It stops on a stone, antennae feeling.
Its eyes glow through the ash.
It loads its legs.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，准备下一次跳
lines.en: It watches, ready for the next hop.

lines.zh: 它被烫得直跳，壳都变了色
lines.en: Heat sets it bouncing, its shell discoloured.

lines.zh: 落地时它的腿折了一下
lines.en: It lands and a leg folds under it.
Water hits and it locks up.
The blast throws it far.
An arrow punches through a wing case.
Odd force sets all six legs kicking.

lines.zh: 饿得跳不远，落地就趴着
lines.en: Starved, it cannot hop far and flops on landing.
Lightning curls it into a ball.

lines.zh: 虚空吸它，它跳起来也逃不掉
lines.en: The void pulls; no hop gets it free.
